finding: The per-round index in the finding key depends on the order of the lines in that round, so the key of one defect changes between rounds.
why: Round 1 reports 'missing null check' at lines 10 and 90, both are fixed, and round 2 reports only line 90: it merges into the line-10 entry, while the real line-90 entry stays fixed and reads as reviewed.
fix: Match a later-round finding to the entry of the same text at the nearest line.
